intro: {{count}} published MBA / PGDM colleges in Hyderabad have a recorded average package higher than their recorded total fee. This shortlist of the best MBA / PGDM colleges in Hyderabad where average package exceeds fees is built only from colleges where we hold both figures.

Department of Business Management, Osmania University, and Osmania University College for Women are the public colleges at the top of this list. Several private engineering-college MBA programmes follow, often with a 2023 placement year.
Recorded fees here are much lower than at national private B-schools. A figure such as ₹27,000 at Sri Indu College may be for one year, so confirm the full MBA cost on the official notice.
listLead: These are the top MBA / PGDM colleges in Hyderabad 2026 that pass this fee–package filter in our records. Several cards show an MBA Finance or Technology Management title, so check whether that is the programme you want.
snapshot: Across {{feeN}} colleges with a recorded fee, the median total is {{feeMedian}}, and the middle half sits between {{feeP25}} and {{feeP75}}.
{{public}} of the {{published}} colleges are public and {{private}} are private. All recorded placement averages on this list are from {{pkgYearMin}}.
The highest recorded package is {{highestMax}}, at CMR College of Engineering & Technology. That is a highest figure for one year, not the average, which we hold at ₹4 lakh for that college.
firstCollegesLead: Osmania University's Department of Business Management is listed with MBA in Technology Management at ₹40,000 and a 2023 average package of ₹8 lakh. Confirm whether the general MBA has a different fee.
Many later cards have no NIRF Management rank in our records. Use the official TS ICET counselling list and the college fee notice, not only the package gap.

sections.heading: How to read Hyderabad MBA fees on this list
paragraphs: State-university and affiliated-college fees in Telangana are often published as an annual figure. If our total looks unusually low, treat it as a prompt to open the official notice.
TS ICET is the most common entrance test on this list. CAT appears for a smaller set of colleges.

compare.heading: How to judge the best MBA / PGDM colleges in Hyderabad where average package exceeds fees
paragraphs: A low fee plus a modest average can still look attractive on paper. Check teaching quality, campus placements for the MBA batch, and whether the college is a university department or an affiliated engineering college.
Use these checks before you apply:
bullets: The official fee for the full two-year MBA, including any university or special-fee components.
Whether admission is through TS ICET counselling or a separate CAT-based process.
The 2023 official placement report, since every recorded average on this list is from that year.
The exact specialisation on the card, such as MBA Finance, and whether a general MBA is offered.

faqs.question: How many MBA colleges in Hyderabad have an average package above fees?
faqs.answer: We list {{published}} published colleges in Hyderabad on this filter. A college is included only when we hold both a total fee and an average package, so other MBA colleges in the city may be missing.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam do Hyderabad MBA colleges on this list accept?
faqs.answer: TS ICET is the most frequently recorded test here, with CAT appearing at fewer colleges. Confirm the latest counselling rules and cut-offs with the college and the official TS ICET process.

faqs.question: Why do some Hyderabad MBA fees look very low?
faqs.answer: Several recorded totals are well under ₹1 lakh and may be annual university or tuition figures rather than the full two-year cost. Check the official fee notice before you treat {{feeMin}} as the complete MBA fee.

faqs.question: Is the highest package a typical offer?
faqs.answer: No. The highest recorded package on this list is {{highestMax}}, which is one offer in one year. The recorded averages here range from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}.

faqs.question: Are these placement figures guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. Every recorded average on this Hyderabad list is from {{pkgYearMin}}. Use the college's latest official placement report for the MBA batch you would join.
